messages:
Sasha: Noticing a sharp 95th/99th latency reg on dedicated-eu1 starting ~18:05 UTC. Throughput fell ~35%, a few tenants reporting errors. Suspect placement concentration + kernel fallbacks.
Ken: Can you attach traces? Any recent infra rollouts or kernel builds?
Sasha: No model changes. We did run a quota redistribution this morning to rebalance guaranteed slots across the pool.
Lia: Pulling runtime logs and KV-cache metrics now.
Lia: Logs show repeated lines: `kernel_selector: desired=opt_attn_v3; probe_failed=abi_mismatch; fallback=generic_attn`. Seen ~900 fallbacks in 12m window. KV-cache miss ratio jumped from 0.18 to 0.68.
Mike: High KV miss + generic kernels explains latency amplification (cache warm + slower kernels). Which hosts are the hot ones?
Sasha: Host mapping: most affected allocations are concentrated on node-eu-12 and node-eu-13. Both got a batch of new tenant assignments after morning redistribution.
OpsLead: Confirmed: redistribution assigned several tenant groups to those two nodes due to a temporary bug in the rebalancer weight logic. Rolling that change back now.
Ken: Flamegraphs attached (18:00-18:15). We see GPU SM stalls and heavy time in generic_attn. Also per-request runtime shows extra memcpy+concat time during KV misses.
Deploy-bot: Incident recorded: INC-20512. Notifying eng-runtime and placement.
Sasha: Quick mitigation idea: enable tenant-level burst for the affected groups to let them spill onto other hosts, and mark node-eu-12/13 as remediation targets for kernel rebuild.
Mike: Also recommend temporarily increasing pool size by +1 node in eu to reduce packing until kernels are reconciled.
Lia: Executing burst toggle for group alpha-stable. Pushing KV-cache warmers for hot prefixes for a few tenants.
OpsLead: Rebalancer rollback initiated and new allocations stopped targeting node-eu-12/13. Scaled pool +1.
Ken: After burst + scale + rollback: 95th latency dropped ~45% in 8 minutes, throughput recovering. Queue depth halved.
Lia: Kernel redeploy job started on node-eu-12/13 with a build compatible with the existing driver. After deploy we see opt_attn_v3 being selected again for most requests.
Sasha: Root cause summary: quota redistribution bug concentrated traffic onto two hosts -> noisy hotspot. Those hosts had a binary/ABI mismatch for the optimized attention kernel causing fallbacks to generic kernels. KV cache miss spike (likely due to eviction pattern from concentrated load) amplified latency.
Mike: Action items: PLAC-429 fix rebalancer weight calculation (ops), RUNTIME-678 add cross-host kernel probe and fail-open detection (eng-runtime), CACHE-212 alert on kv_miss_ratio > 0.4 sustained for >2m (observability). I'll create tickets.
Lia: Added raw logs and perf traces to INC-20512.
oncall-bot: INC-20512 status=mitigated.
Sasha: Good job. Scheduling 45m postmortem tomorrow 10:00 CET. Please bring kernel-selector probes and rebalancer diffs. :thumbsup:
